Rules.InvariantScript:
Sort(
    Distinct(
        Filter(
            'dim.Ref.Organizations',
            !IsBlank('Wave Number') &&
            'Wave Number' <> "Wave" &&
            'Wave Number' <> "NULL" &&
            !IsBlank('SubWave2 Code') &&
            'SubWave2 Code' <> "SubWave" &&
            'SubWave2 Code' <> "NULL"
        ),
        'Wave Number' & " - " & 'SubWave2 Code'
    ),
    Value,
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

Text(
    Round(
        100 *
        Sum(
            colRegReadiness,
            LiveRecords
        ) /
        Max(
            1,
            Sum(
                colRegReadiness,
                TotalRecords
            )
        ),
        0
    )
) & "%"

Text(
    Round(
        100 *
        (
            Sum(
                colRegReadiness,
                TestRecords
            ) +
            Sum(
                colRegReadiness,
                ZconRecords
            ) +
            Sum(
                colRegReadiness,
                LiveRecords
            )
        ) /
        Max(
            1,
            Sum(
                colRegReadiness,
                TotalRecords
            )
        ),
        0
    )
) & "%"

Text(
    Round(
        100 *
        Sum(
            colRegReadiness,
            LiveRecords
        ) /
        Max(
            1,
            Sum(
                colRegReadiness,
                TotalRecords
            )
        ),
        0
    )
) & "%"
